correctness.rationale: For each non-rainbow clique coloring, a consistent integer one-Lipschitz lift evolves by h_{t+1}(v)=max_{u in N[v]}h_t(u); its global maximum propagates by diameter D, and the distance-to-diametral-vertex construction attains D. For a rainbow clique, the core advances at every step and a rooted-tree lift obeys b_a+t-d(a,v) <= h_t(v) <= max(M_a,b_a+t-d(a,v)), M_a<=b_a+H_a; at t>=H_a+d(a,v) it is the unique traveling wave. A deepest-leaf initial height b_a+d(a,v) attains 2H. Rainbow clique phases count R_c=3^c-3*2^c+3, giving R_c/3 primitive orbits, individual orbit basin 3^(k+1), fixed point basin 3^k(2^c-1). Integer connected same-color states cannot have different heights because local differences <=1. Direct independent enumeration on one depth-3 graft and a 4-clique branched graft covered 729 and 2187 states, reproducing D, 2H, basin sizes and periods; this is corroboration only, not a proof for arbitrary c,T.
